verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a 'Secure Cloud' tier whose machines are verified to sit in certified datacenters with a Tier 2/3 rating or ISO 27001, marked with a blue label and recommended for production. That covers the datacenter-tier part of the story. A community thread reports a host misrepresenting its location, which calls into question how reliable host-level claims are. It is not shown to involve a Secure Cloud machine, so it lowers confidence rather than disputing the tier claim. Missing for 10: SOC 2 attestation or report access, documented data-handling and privacy policy for customer models and data, a trust or compliance portal, and independent corroboration of datacenter verification.
